Frequently Asked Questions

Regardless of the country, students can be expected to spend around Rs. 30-32 lakh per year studying abroad. This would include tuition fees of Rs. 15-20 lakh and living expenses of Rs. 10-12 lakh. The cost of studying abroad depends on the selected country, course, and the university. For instance
  1. The average tuition fees at public and private universities in the USA are $25,620 and $34,740 respectively. Living costs are estimated at $10,800.
  2. In the UK, the average cost of attendance for international students is £22,180 per year. (the amount is high if you study in London)
  3. There is no tuition fee in some countries like Germany.
  4. In Australia, the estimated average tuition fee for studying ranges from AU$30,840 to AU$31,596. The amount can vary depending on the programs students choose to study.
Studying abroad offers global exposure, diverse cultures, advanced research, and better career prospects, while studying in India is cost-effective and close to home. The choice depends on your goals. Kanan International assists with personalized counselling, university selection, test prep, visa guidance, and financial planning—helping students make the right decision and smoothly transition to top international institutions.
For diploma or short term courses ₹20 lakhs can be enough to study abroad, especially in countries like Canada, Germany, Ireland, or some European nations with low tuition or public funding. However, in countries like the US, UK, or Australia, it may only cover the first year. At Kanan International, our unique study abroad model helps students maximize scholarships, select affordable programs, and plan finances smartly—making global education accessible even with a moderate budget.
International students are advised to start their preparation as per the university’s deadlines. Generally, they have to wait until they receive their confirmation letter from the university before applying for the student visa. To ensure a smooth application process, students should apply atleast 3 to 4 months in advance.
For all study abroad aspirants, the general visa process is
  1. Choose the visa type
  2. Apply for the visa online or offline
  3. Pay the visa application fee
  4. Schedule a visa interview and attend it
  5. After attending the interview, wait for the application to be processed.
  6. Make the travel arrangements after final confirmation (approved/rejected) from visa authorities to avoid loss of money.
The documents required for student visa application are:
  1. Valid Passport
  2. Proof of funding
  3. Proof of language proficiency
  4. Letter of acceptance from university
  5. Medical examination report
